tables.name: intra_entropy_model
tables.used_for: I-frame latent symbols (every GOP's first frame)
tables.table_grouping: one table per latent channel (channel-major, matching latent_to_symbols' coding order)
tables.symbol_source: quantized latents of EVERY frame scanned during calibration (I- and P-typed alike - the intra grid/table must cover the full latent distribution, not just I-frame-typed positions)
tables.fitting_data: first 400 frames reached while scanning TRAIN sequences in manifest order, capped at --calibration-frames=400
tables.normalization: floor(p*65536), MIN_FREQUENCY=1 floor, deterministic largest-first residual redistribution
tables.coder_usage: encode_latent_to_payload/decode_payload_to_latent -> encode_symbols/decode_symbols, one table per channel, STATELESS (not through ResumableDecoder today)
tables.recalibration_note: quantization params (intra_params) are FROZEN and produce the symbols; only the FREQUENCY table can change without altering a single symbol

tables.name: motion_entropy_model
tables.table_grouping: table 0 = every dy symbol, table 1 = every dx symbol (motion_table_index) - ONE shared identity for both
tables.symbol_source: estimate_block_motion's real block-matched (dy, dx) vectors on frames scanned during calibration, shifted by +search_range (motion_to_symbols) - fully deterministic given the frozen motion estimator, no entropy model involved in SYMBOL generation at all
tables.fitting_data: 358 P-frames reached while scanning TRAIN sequences in manifest order, capped at --calibration-frames=400 TOTAL (I+P) frames scanned
tables.normalization: floor(p*65536), MIN_FREQUENCY=1 floor, deterministic largest-first residual redistribution
tables.coder_usage: encode_motion_payload/decode_motion_payload -> encode_symbols/decode_symbols, 2 tables, ONE-SHOT (not grouped, not through ResumableDecoder)
tables.recalibration_note: motion vectors depend only on the FROZEN motion estimator/block_size/search_range/GOP, never on any entropy table - recalibrating changes zero motion symbols by construction

tables.name: residual_entropy_model (calibrate_grids, M10H-style per-channel)
tables.used_for: NOTHING in the M13-deployed closed loop - superseded by M11-G16 + M13's recalibrated 512-entry codebook for every P-frame residual. `calibrate_grids` still computes and returns it (a shared utility also used by earlier M10G/M10H-era scripts), but scripts/m13_closed_loop.py never reads calibration['residual_entropy_model'] - only calibration['residual_params'] (the QUANTIZATION grid, which IS live) is used from this part of the calibration dict.
tables.symbol_source: N/A - not used for deployed coding
tables.fitting_data: N/A - not used for deployed coding
tables.smoothing_method: N/A - not used for deployed coding
tables.normalization: N/A - not used for deployed coding
tables.provenance_identity_fn: N/A - not used for deployed coding
tables.coder_usage: NONE (dead weight in the M13 deployment path)
tables.recalibration_note: NOT A CANDIDATE: recalibrating a table nothing reads cannot produce any deployed byte change. Documented here because Phase A asked to inspect every static table calibrate_grids builds, not just the live ones.

tables.name: m11_g16_residual_codebook (M13's ALREADY-recalibrated table)
tables.used_for: P-frame residual latent symbols (the M13 baseline this milestone freezes)
tables.table_grouping: 512 shared prototypes, assigned per-position via SharedCodebook.assign_tensor (M11-G16's own channel-autoregressive prediction)
tables.symbol_source: TRAIN residual symbols actually assigned to each prototype by the DEPLOYED M11-G16 model (M13's recalibration target)
tables.fitting_data: 536 TRAIN P-frames (m11_data cache) - ALREADY recalibrated by M13; FROZEN as this milestone's baseline, not re-touched
tables.smoothing_method: M11 causal-context hierarchical smoothing toward the pre-recalibration prior, strength chosen on VAL-A (scripts/m13_recalibration.py, M13, frozen)
tables.normalization: probabilities_to_frequencies (same function family as the other tables' Laplace path, different smoothing input)
tables.provenance_identity_fn: m11_ar_entropy.model_identity(model, codebook=coding_codebook) - hashes model weights + codebook frequencies together
tables.recalibration_note: FROZEN by M14's own rules - 'M13 recalibrated M11-G16 configuration as the temporal baseline'. Not a candidate; listed for completeness of the inventory.
